right-neowiki-schema-edit:
{{doc-right|neowiki-schema-edit}}
Name of the user right required to create and edit pages in the NeoWiki Schema namespace.
right-neowiki-layout-edit:
{{doc-right|neowiki-layout-edit}}
Name of the user right required to create and edit pages in the NeoWiki Layout namespace.
right-neowiki-mapping-edit:
{{doc-right|neowiki-mapping-edit}}
Name of the user right required to create and edit pages in the NeoWiki Mapping namespace.
right-neowiki-query:
{{doc-right|neowiki-query}}
Name of the user right required to run NeoWiki queries, such as via the Cypher query API.
right-neowiki-admin:
{{doc-right|neowiki-admin}}
Name of the user right required to report and rebuild the wiki's graph stores.
specialpages-group-neowiki: Group heading for NeoWiki special pages on [[Special:SpecialPages]].
neowiki-special-schemas: Title and description of the [[Special:Schemas]] page. Also the caption of the Schema table on that page and on [[Special:NeoWiki]].
neowiki-special-createsubject: Title and description of the [[Special:CreateSubject]] page, which creates a page together with its Main Subject. A subpage names the Schema to use, e.g. Special:CreateSubject/Person.
neowiki-schema-label: Names a subject's schema. $1 is the schema name or a link to it. Also used as the accessible name of the schema badge, whose visible text is the bare name.
neowiki-cypher-raw-error-json-encode: Error message shown when JSON encoding of query results fails.
neowiki-cypher-error-permission-denied: Error shown on the {{#cypher_raw}} parser function and the nw.query() Lua function when the user the page is parsed for lacks the neowiki-query right.
neowiki-cypher-error-empty-query: Error shown on the {{#cypher_raw}} parser function and the nw.query() Lua function when the supplied Cypher query is empty or only whitespace.
neowiki-cypher-error-write-query: Error shown on the {{#cypher_raw}} parser function and the nw.query() Lua function when the query contains a write operation. Cypher queries from wikitext are restricted to read-only.
neowiki-cypher-error-syntax: Error shown when Neo4j reports a syntax error for a Cypher query run from wikitext. $1 is the verbatim Neo4j-supplied syntax detail and is not translatable.
neowiki-cypher-error-parameter-missing: Error shown when a Cypher query run from wikitext references a parameter that was not supplied. $1 is the verbatim Neo4j-supplied detail and is not translatable.
neowiki-cypher-error-timeout: Error shown when a Cypher query run from wikitext exceeds the allowed time limit. $1 is the verbatim Neo4j-supplied detail and is not translatable.
neowiki-cypher-error-backend-unavailable: Error shown when the graph database backend cannot be reached for a Cypher query run from wikitext. The underlying connection detail is intentionally omitted.
neowiki-cypher-error-internal: Generic fallback error shown for a Cypher query run from wikitext that fails for a reason not covered by the more specific cases. $1 is the verbatim underlying detail and is not translatable.
neowiki-sparql-raw-error-json-encode: Error message shown when JSON encoding of SPARQL query results fails.
neowiki-sparql-error-permission-denied: Error shown on the {{#sparql_raw}} parser function and the nw.sparqlQuery() Lua function when the user the page is parsed for lacks the neowiki-query right.
neowiki-sparql-error-empty-query: Error shown on the {{#sparql_raw}} parser function and the nw.sparqlQuery() Lua function when the supplied SPARQL query is empty or only whitespace.
neowiki-sparql-error-syntax: Error shown when the SPARQL store rejects a query run from wikitext (a 4xx response, most commonly a syntax error). $1 is the verbatim store-supplied detail and is not translatable.
neowiki-sparql-error-store-unavailable: Error shown when the SPARQL store cannot be reached for a query run from wikitext (a 5xx response or a transport error). The underlying connection detail is intentionally omitted.
neowiki-sparql-error-internal: Generic fallback error shown for a SPARQL query run from wikitext that fails for a reason not covered by the more specific cases. $1 is the verbatim underlying detail and is not translatable.
neowiki-view-error-extra-positional: Error shown when {{#view}} is called with more than one positional argument. $1 is the offending extra argument value.
neowiki-view-error-conflicting-subject: Error shown when {{#view}} receives a Subject ID as both a positional argument and a named subject= argument.
neowiki-view-error-unknown-arg: Error shown when {{#view}} receives an unrecognized named argument. $1 is the offending argument name.
neowiki-page-tools-label: Heading for the NeoWiki section in the MediaWiki sidebar (shown as a group label in legacy skins and inside the page tools menu in modern Vector).
neowiki-page-tools-create-subject: Label for the link in the NeoWiki section of the sidebar that opens the Subject creator on the page being viewed, with that page preselected. The dialog creates the page's Main Subject if it has none, or another Subject otherwise. Pages that cannot open the creator link to [[Special:CreateSubject]] instead, under {{msg-mw|neowiki-sidebar-create-subject}}, which reads the same.
neowiki-page-tools-manage-subjects: Label for the sidebar link to the Subject management page, shown to users who may edit. See neowiki-page-tools-view-subjects for the read-only variant.
neowiki-page-tools-view-subjects: Read-only counterpart of neowiki-page-tools-manage-subjects: label for the sidebar link to the Subject management page, shown to users who lack edit permission.
neowiki-page-tools-edit-json: Label for the sidebar link that navigates to Special:NeoJson for the current page. Only visible when development UIs are enabled.
neowiki-page-tools-view-json: Read-only counterpart of neowiki-page-tools-edit-json: label for the sidebar link to Special:NeoJson, shown to users who lack edit permission. Only visible when development UIs are enabled.
neowiki-page-tools-rdf: Label for the sidebar link that opens the current page's RDF export (Turtle serialization of the page's Subjects), served by the per-page RDF REST endpoint. Only shown when the page has NeoWiki Subjects.
neowiki-subject-creator-creating-schema: Subtitle shown in the subject creator dialog header when the user is creating a new schema.
neowiki-subject-creator-create-schema: Label for the button that creates a new schema in the subject creator dialog.
neowiki-subject-creator-continue: Label for the button that continues from schema creation to subject editing in the subject creator dialog.
neowiki-subject-creator-schema-created: Success notification shown after creating a schema.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-field: Label of the field group in the 'create subject' dialog that picks which page the Subject goes on.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-section: Title of the collapsible section of the 'create subject' dialog that holds the page choice, and, while it is collapsed, the choice made; it is also the header of the non-expandable block a {{#create_subject}} button shows when the page is fixed: {{msg-mw|neowiki-subject-creator-page-section-this}} and its siblings continue this title, so 'Store the subject on' plus 'this page' must read as one phrase.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-section-thi: The choice shown in the header of the collapsed page section, continuing {{msg-mw|neowiki-subject-creator-page-section}}: the page the dialog was opened on. Lower case, as the end of that phrase.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-section-ano: The choice shown in the header of the collapsed page section, continuing {{msg-mw|neowiki-subject-creator-page-section}}: a page that exists, none of which is picked yet, where the dialog was opened on a page of its own.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-section-exi: The choice shown in the header of the collapsed page section, continuing {{msg-mw|neowiki-subject-creator-page-section}}: a page that exists, none of which is picked yet, where the dialog was opened on no page of its own.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-section-pic:
The choice shown in the header of the collapsed page section, continuing {{msg-mw|neowiki-subject-creator-page-section}}: the page picked. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title
neowiki-subject-creator-page-section-new: The choice shown in the header of the collapsed page section, continuing {{msg-mw|neowiki-subject-creator-page-section}}: a page created for the Subject, whose title is left to the wiki.

The choice shown in the header of the collapsed page section, continuing {{msg-mw|neowiki-subject-creator-page-section}}: a page created for the Subject under the title given. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title
neowiki-subject-creator-page-this: Label of the option that puts the Subject on the page the 'create subject' dialog was opened from.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-another: Label of the option that puts the Subject on an existing page the user picks in the 'create subject' dialog, where the dialog was opened on a page of its own. {{msg-mw|neowiki-subject-creator-page-existing}} names the same option where it was not.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-existing: Label of the option that puts the Subject on an existing page the user picks in the 'create subject' dialog, where the dialog was opened on no page of its own - Special:CreateSubject, a Schema page - so there is no page to call it another of. {{msg-mw|neowiki-subject-creator-page-another}} names the same option where there is.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-new: Label of the option that gives the Subject a page of its own, created together with it by the 'create subject' dialog.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-picked:
Note in the 'create subject' dialog when the page picked has no Main Subject of its own. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title
neowiki-subject-creator-page-has-main-su:
Note in the 'create subject' dialog when the chosen page already has a Main Subject. Parameters:
* $1 - the display name of that Main Subject
neowiki-subject-creator-page-title-field: Label of the optional field in the 'create subject' dialog that titles the page created for the Subject.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-title-help: Help text below the page-title field in the 'create subject' dialog, naming what titles the page when the field is left empty. The field is only shown on a page-first wiki, so there is no fallback beyond the label.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-title-requi: Error shown at the page-title field of the 'create subject' dialog when a new page is to be created and neither a page title nor a Subject label was given. On a page-first wiki, a new page is never titled after a Subject ID.
neowiki-subject-creator-page-title-inval:
Error shown at the page-title field of the 'create subject' dialog when the title given can title no page. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title given
neowiki-subject-creator-page-taken:
Error shown in the 'create subject' dialog, at the page title field of its "Store the subject on" section, when the title chosen for the new page is already taken. The user can either pick that page under the existing-page option or change the title. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title
neowiki-subject-creator-page-taken-fixed:
Error shown in the 'create subject' dialog when the page it would create, titled after the Subject's label, is already taken, and the dialog was opened for a fixed new page, so the label is the only thing the user can change. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title
neowiki-subject-creator-page-read-error:
Error shown at the page field of the 'create subject' dialog when the chosen page's Subjects could not be read. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title
neowiki-createsubject-button: Label of the button that opens the 'create subject' dialog: the main button on [[Special:NeoWiki]], and the button on [[Special:CreateSubject]] that reopens the dialog after it was closed.
neowiki-schema-editor-summary-default: Default edit summary used when updating a schema via the UI.
neowiki-schema-editor-success: Success notification shown after updating a schema. $1 is the schema name.
neowiki-schema-editor-error: Error notification title shown when updating a schema fails. $1 is the schema name.
neowiki-schema-editor-new-property: Label for the button that adds a new property definition in the schema editor. Translations can only exceed the English length a little bit.
neowiki-schema-editor-delete-property: Aria label for the button that deletes a property definition in the schema editor.
neowiki-schema-editor-description: Label for the description field in the schema editor.
neowiki-schema-editor-resize-property-li: Accessible name of the divider between the property list and the property editor in the schema editor. Dragging it, or moving it with the arrow keys, changes how wide the property list is.
neowiki-schema-editor-description-placeh: Placeholder text for the description field in the schema editor.
neowiki-schema-editor-description-edit: Accessibility label and tooltip for the button that starts editing the schema description in the schema editor dialog header.
neowiki-schema-editor-description-expand: Accessibility label and tooltip for the button that expands a schema description truncated to two lines.
neowiki-schema-editor-description-collap: Accessibility label and tooltip for the button that collapses an expanded schema description back to two lines.
neowiki-schema-editor-description-add: Label of the button that starts writing a description for a schema that has none, shown in the schema editor dialog header.
neowiki-subject-generated-name: The name shown for a subject that has no label of its own, so its name was derived from its schema rather than chosen by anyone. $1 is the schema name: a noun the wiki's own users invented, in an unknown language and grammatical gender, so do not inflect it, do not change its case, and make no word agree with it. The round brackets mark the whole string as a stand-in the system supplied rather than a name someone typed, as in {{msg-mw|Blanknamespace}}; use whichever brackets your language uses for that.
neowiki-search-hit-subject: Names the subject a search result matched, shown above the matching values. $1 is the subject's name and $2 the name of its schema: both are words the wiki's own users chose, in an unknown language and grammatical gender, so do not inflect them, do not change their case, and make no word agree with them. The round brackets set the schema name apart from the subject's name; use whichever brackets your language uses for that.
neowiki-subject-editor-title: Title of the subject editor dialog, and its accessible name. Names the task rather than a subject: the dialog can edit several at once, and each one is named by the pane that edits it.
neowiki-subject-editor-label-field: Accessibility label for the input shown in place of the dialog title while renaming a subject in the subject editor dialog.
neowiki-subject-editor-rename: Accessibility label for the button next to the subject editor dialog title that starts renaming the subject.
neowiki-subject-editor-open-target:
Label and tooltip of the control shown at the end of a relation field that is displaying its target, in the subject editor, which opens that subject for editing alongside the one being edited. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the subject it opens.
neowiki-subject-editor-summary-default: Default edit summary used when updating a subject via the UI.
neowiki-subject-editor-summary-default-c: Default edit summary used when creating a subject via the UI.
neowiki-subject-editor-success: Success notification shown after updating a subject. $1 is the name the subject is shown under: a stored label, or a bracketed stand-in such as "(unnamed Attendance)" for a subject nobody named. Keep the quotation marks around it, because a stored label is arbitrary text and needs delimiting.
neowiki-subject-editor-success-multiple: Success notification shown after one save updated several subjects. $1 is how many.
neowiki-subject-editor-error: Error notification title shown when updating a subject fails. $1 is the name the subject is shown under: a stored label, or a bracketed stand-in such as "(unnamed Attendance)" for a subject nobody named. Keep the quotation marks around it, because a stored label is arbitrary text and needs delimiting.
neowiki-subject-editor-validation-failed: Toast title shown when the backend rejects a Subject save under enforcement. $1 is the name the subject is shown under: a stored label, or a bracketed stand-in such as "(unnamed Attendance)" for a subject nobody named. Keep the quotation marks around it, because a stored label is arbitrary text and needs delimiting.
neowiki-subject-editor-stored-on: Line in a subject editing pane saying which wiki page the subject is stored on. Parameters: $1 - the page name, which is rendered as a link to that page. The rest of the message is not part of the link.
neowiki-subject-editor-unsaved: Tooltip of the dot indicating a subject editing pane has unsaved changes.
neowiki-subject-editor-target-load-error: Error notification when a relation target subject could not be fetched for editing (missing, unreadable, or network failure).
neowiki-subject-editor-create-target-err: Error notification when a new subject could not be created from a relation field, because its schema or an identifier for it could not be fetched, or because no page could be determined to store it on.
neowiki-subject-editor-partial-save:
Message shown in the subject editor's footer when a multi-subject save wrote some subjects and then failed. Parameters:
* $1 - how many subjects were written, at least one
* $2 - how many the save attempted, at least two
neowiki-subject-editor-save-scope:
Note shown beside the subject editor's save button, naming what the save writes. Parameters:
* $1 - how many subjects the save writes
* $2 - how many wiki pages hold them
Shown only when the user cannot see the whole scope already, so $1 is at least two or the one changed subject is not the one on screen.
neowiki-subject-editor-open-subjects: Accessible name of the list of subjects open in the subject editor, which the user selects one of to edit it. Shown only once a second subject has been opened.
neowiki-subject-editor-resize-navigator: Accessible name of the divider between the list of subjects and the edit form in the subject editor. Dragging it, or moving it with the arrow keys, changes how wide the list is. The list itself is named by {{msg-mw|neowiki-subject-editor-open-subjects}}.
neowiki-subject-picker-placeholder: Placeholder text shown in the subject picker input field, which matches typed text against subject names and accepts a complete subject ID.
neowiki-schema-picker-placeholder: Placeholder text shown in the schema picker input field.
neowiki-subject-picker-no-results: Message shown in the subject picker dropdown when no subjects match the search query.
neowiki-subject-picker-no-match: Error message shown in the subject picker when the user types text but does not select a subject from the dropdown results.
neowiki-subject-picker-create:
Label of the option at the bottom of the subject picker dropdown that creates a new subject, shown when the user has typed nothing. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the schema the new subject will use
neowiki-subject-picker-create-named:
Label of the option at the bottom of the subject picker dropdown that creates a new subject named after what the user typed. Parameters:
* $1 - the text the user typed, which becomes the new subject's label
* $2 - the name of the schema the new subject will use
neowiki-page-picker-placeholder: Placeholder text shown in the wiki page search input field.
neowiki-page-picker-no-results: Message shown in the page picker dropdown when no pages match the search query.
neowiki-page-picker-create-hint: Label of the unpickable option at the bottom of the page picker dropdown, shown while the user has typed nothing, telling them that typing a title offers a page that does not exist yet.
neowiki-page-picker-create-named:
Label of the option at the bottom of the page picker dropdown that picks a page which does not exist yet. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title the user typed
neowiki-schema-creator-title: Title of the dialog for creating a new schema.
neowiki-schema-creator-button: Label for the button that opens the schema creation dialog on [[Special:Schemas]].
neowiki-schema-creator-name-field: Label for the schema name input field in the schema creation dialog.
neowiki-schema-creator-name-placeholder: Placeholder text for the schema name input field in the schema creation dialog.
neowiki-schema-creator-name-required: Error shown when the schema name field is empty in the schema creation dialog.
neowiki-schema-creator-name-taken: Error shown when a schema with the entered name already exists in the schema creation dialog.
neowiki-schema-creator-save: Label for the save button in the schema creation dialog.
neowiki-schema-creator-success: Success notification shown after creating a schema. $1 is the schema name.
neowiki-schema-creator-error: Error notification title shown when creating a schema fails. $1 is the schema name.
neowiki-schema-creator-summary-default: Default edit summary used when creating a schema via the UI.
neowiki-schemas-column-name: Column header for schema name in the schemas list table on [[Special:Schemas]] and on [[Special:NeoWiki]].
neowiki-schemas-column-description: Column header for schema description in the schemas list table on [[Special:Schemas]] and on [[Special:NeoWiki]].
neowiki-schemas-column-properties: Column header for the number of property definitions in the schemas list table on [[Special:Schemas]].
neowiki-schemas-empty: Message shown when no schemas exist yet on [[Special:Schemas]] and on [[Special:NeoWiki]].
neowiki-schema-sidebar-all-schemas: Label for the link in the NeoWiki section of the sidebar on Schema pages that navigates to [[Special:Schemas]].
neowiki-sidebar-create-subject: Label for the link in the NeoWiki section of the sidebar that navigates to [[Special:CreateSubject]], where a Subject is created together with a page of its own by default, or added to a page picked there. Shown only where {{msg-mw|neowiki-page-tools-create-subject}} is not, so a page carries one Create subject entry rather than two; the two read the same.
neowiki-schema-create-subject:
Label of the button that opens the 'create subject' dialog with a Schema chosen. Used on the Schema's own page, in each row of the Schema tables on [[Special:Schemas]] (as the accessible name and tooltip of an icon button) and [[Special:NeoWiki]], and where {{#create_subject}} names a Schema. Parameters:
* $1 - the Schema name
neowiki-schema-delete: Aria label for the delete button on a Schema row in the schemas list.
neowiki-close-confirmation-title: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when closing a dialog with unsaved changes.
neowiki-close-confirmation-message: Message in the confirmation dialog asking the user to confirm discarding unsaved changes.
neowiki-close-confirmation-discard: Label for the destructive button that discards unsaved changes and closes the dialog.
neowiki-close-confirmation-keep-editing: Label for the button that dismisses the confirmation and returns to editing.
neowiki-schema-abandonment-title: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when closing the subject creator with an unsaved draft schema.
neowiki-schema-abandonment-message: Message explaining that both the new schema and subject will be lost.
neowiki-schema-abandonment-abandon: Label for the destructive button that discards both the schema and subject.
neowiki-schema-abandonment-keep-editing: Label for the button that returns to editing the subject.
neowiki-schema-abandonment-save-schema: Label for the quiet button that saves only the schema and discards the subject.
neowiki-schema-invalid:
Error message shown when saving a structurally invalid Schema. Parameters:
* $1 - number of validation errors
* $2 - semicolon-separated list of {{msg-mw|neowiki-schema-invalid-detail}}, one per error
neowiki-schema-invalid-detail:
One line of detail for a single Schema validation error. Parameters:
* $1 - JSON pointer to the location of the error
* $2 - the validation error message
neowiki-schema-name-invalid:
Error message shown when a Schema page title is not a valid schema name (empty or reserved). Parameters:
* $1 - the reason the name is invalid
neowiki-layout-invalid:
Error message shown when saving an invalid Layout. Parameters:
* $1 - number of validation errors
* $2 - semicolon-separated list of {{msg-mw|neowiki-layout-invalid-detail}}, one per error
neowiki-layout-invalid-detail:
One line of detail for a single Layout validation error. Parameters:
* $1 - JSON pointer to the location of the error
* $2 - the validation error message
neowiki-layout-name-invalid:
Error message shown when a Layout page title is not a valid layout name (empty). Parameters:
* $1 - the reason the name is invalid
neowiki-mapping-invalid:
Error message shown when saving a structurally or semantically invalid ontology Mapping. Parameters:
* $1 - number of validation errors
* $2 - semicolon-separated list of {{msg-mw|neowiki-mapping-invalid-detail}}, one per error
neowiki-mapping-invalid-detail:
One line of detail for a single Mapping validation error. Parameters:
* $1 - JSON pointer to the location of the error
* $2 - the validation error message
neowiki-mapping-name-invalid:
Error message shown when a Mapping page title is not a valid mapping name (empty or the reserved name "native"). Parameters:
* $1 - the reason the name is invalid
neowiki-edit-layout: Aria label for the edit button on a Layout page.
neowiki-layout-display-schema: Label for the schema field in the layout display.
neowiki-layout-display-view-type: Label for the view type field in the layout display.
neowiki-layout-display-rules-caption: Caption for the display rules table in the layout display (hidden visually).
neowiki-layout-display-rule-property: Column header for the property name in the display rules table.
neowiki-layout-display-rule-type: Column header for the property type in the display rules table.
neowiki-layout-display-rule-attributes: Column header for display attributes in the display rules table.
neowiki-layout-display-no-rules: Message shown when a layout has no display rules, meaning all schema properties are shown in their default order.
neowiki-layout-sidebar-all-layouts: Label for the link in the NeoWiki section of the sidebar on Layout pages that navigates to [[Special:Layouts]].
neowiki-editing-layout: Title of the dialog for editing a layout. $1 is the layout name.
neowiki-save-layout: Label for the save button in the layout editor dialog.
neowiki-edit-summary-help-text-layout: Help text shown below the edit summary in the layout editor dialog.
neowiki-delete-confirm-title: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before deleting a NeoWiki page (Schema, Layout, or Mapping). $1 is the entity name.
neowiki-delete-confirm-message: Body of the delete confirmation dialog. $1 is the entity type noun (see neowiki-schema-noun etc.) followed by the entity name in bold, e.g. "schema '''Foo'''".
neowiki-delete-confirm-button: Label for the button that confirms deletion in the delete confirmation dialog.
neowiki-schema-noun: Lowercase common noun for a Schema, used inside sentences such as the delete confirmation message ("The schema Foo will be deleted").
neowiki-layout-noun: Lowercase common noun for a Layout, used inside sentences such as the delete confirmation message ("The layout Foo will be deleted").
neowiki-mapping-noun: Lowercase common noun for an ontology Mapping, used inside sentences such as the delete confirmation message ("The mapping Foo will be deleted").
neowiki-delete-reason-label: Label for the optional deletion-reason field in the delete confirmation dialog.
neowiki-delete-reason-placeholder: Placeholder for the optional deletion-reason field in the delete confirmation dialog.
neowiki-delete-summary-default: Default deletion reason recorded in the deletion log when the user enters none.
neowiki-delete-success: Success notification shown after a page is deleted. $1 is the page name.
neowiki-delete-error: Error notification title shown when deleting a page fails. $1 is the page name.
neowiki-layout-editor-description: Label for the description field in the layout editor.
neowiki-layout-editor-description-placeh: Placeholder text for the description field in the layout editor.
neowiki-layout-editor-schema: Label for the read-only schema field in the layout editor.
neowiki-layout-editor-view-type: Label for the read-only view type field in the layout editor.
neowiki-layout-editor-show-all-propertie: Label for the button that reveals all hidden properties, keeping the existing order of the shown ones.
neowiki-layout-editor-shown-count: Header in the display rule editor showing how many properties are visible. $1 is the number shown; $2 is the total number of properties.
neowiki-layout-editor-show-property: Aria label for the per-row toggle button that makes a hidden property visible in the display rule editor.
neowiki-layout-editor-hide-property: Aria label for the per-row toggle button that hides a visible property in the display rule editor.
neowiki-layout-editor-keep-one-shown: Tooltip on the disabled visibility toggle of the last shown property, explaining that at least one property must remain shown.
neowiki-layout-editor-summary-default: Default edit summary used when updating a layout via the UI.
neowiki-layout-editor-success: Success notification shown after updating a layout. $1 is the layout name.
neowiki-layout-editor-error: Error notification title shown when updating a layout fails. $1 is the layout name.
neowiki-layout-editor-schema-fetch-error: Error message shown in the layout editor when the schema properties could not be loaded.
neowiki-special-layouts: Title and description of the [[Special:Layouts]] page. Also the title of its card on [[Special:NeoWiki]].
neowiki-layouts-column-name: Column header for layout name in the layouts list table on [[Special:Layouts]].
neowiki-layouts-column-schema: Column header for the schema name in the layouts list table on [[Special:Layouts]].
neowiki-layouts-column-type: Column header for the view type in the layouts list table on [[Special:Layouts]].
neowiki-layouts-column-description: Column header for layout description in the layouts list table on [[Special:Layouts]].
neowiki-layouts-empty: Message shown when no layouts exist yet on [[Special:Layouts]].
neowiki-special-mappings: Title and description of the [[Special:Mappings]] page, which lists the ontology mapping pages. Also the title of its card on [[Special:NeoWiki]].
neowiki-mappings-column-name: Column header for mapping name in the mappings list table on [[Special:Mappings]].
neowiki-mappings-column-schemas: Column header for the mapped schemas in the mappings list table on [[Special:Mappings]]. The cell lists the mapped Schema names followed by their count.
neowiki-mappings-schema-count: Parenthesized count of mapped schemas, shown after the list of Schema names in a row of the mappings list table on [[Special:Mappings]]. $1 is the number of mapped schemas.
neowiki-mappings-schemas-none: Placeholder shown in the mapped-schemas cell of a row on [[Special:Mappings]] when the Mapping has no mapped Schemas.
neowiki-mappings-empty: Message shown when no mappings exist yet on [[Special:Mappings]].
neowiki-mapping-sidebar-all-mappings: Label for the link in the NeoWiki section of the sidebar on Mapping pages that navigates to [[Special:Mappings]].
neowiki-mapping-creator-button: Label for the button that opens the mapping creation dialog on [[Special:Mappings]].
neowiki-mapping-creator-title: Title of the dialog for creating a new ontology mapping.
neowiki-mapping-creator-name-field: Label for the mapping name field in the mapping creation dialog.
neowiki-mapping-creator-name-placeholder: Placeholder text for the mapping name field in the mapping creation dialog.
neowiki-mapping-creator-name-required: Inline validation error shown when the mapping name field is left empty.
neowiki-mapping-creator-name-reserved: Inline validation error shown when the entered mapping name is the reserved projection name "native".
neowiki-mapping-creator-name-taken: Inline validation error shown when a mapping with the entered name already exists.
neowiki-mapping-creator-save: Label for the save button in the mapping creation dialog.
neowiki-mapping-creator-error: Error notification title shown when creating a mapping fails. $1 is the mapping name.
neowiki-mapping-creator-summary-default: Default edit summary used when creating a mapping via the UI.
neowiki-edit-mapping: Aria label for the edit button on a Mapping row in the mappings list.
neowiki-mapping-delete: Aria label for the delete button on a Mapping row in the mappings list.
neowiki-mapping-page-version:
Format version shown as a subtle line at the top of the read view of a Mapping page. Parameters:
* $1 - the mapping format version number
neowiki-mapping-page-schemas-heading: Heading for the overview table on the read view of a Mapping page that lists the mapped Schemas, each linked to its Schema page.
neowiki-mapping-page-schema-column: Column header for the Schema name in the mapped-schemas overview table on a Mapping page.
neowiki-mapping-page-class-column: Column header for the target ontology class in the mapped-schemas overview table on a Mapping page.
neowiki-mapping-page-properties-column: Column header for the number of mapped properties in the mapped-schemas overview table on a Mapping page.
neowiki-mapping-page-no-schemas: Message shown on the read view of a Mapping page that maps no Schemas. Tone matches {{msg-mw|neowiki-mappings-empty}}.
neowiki-mapping-page-prefixes-heading: Heading for the table on the read view of a Mapping page that lists the namespace prefixes the mapping declares.
neowiki-mapping-page-prefix-column: Column header for the prefix in the prefixes table on a Mapping page.
neowiki-mapping-page-namespace-column: Column header for the namespace IRI in the prefixes table on a Mapping page.
neowiki-mapping-unsupported-version:
Warning shown above the JSON of a Mapping page written in a format version this NeoWiki cannot read. Parameters:
* $1 - the format version found on the page
neowiki-layout-creator-title: Title of the dialog for creating a new layout.
neowiki-layout-creator-button: Label for the button that opens the layout creation dialog on [[Special:Layouts]].
neowiki-layout-creator-name-field: Label for the layout name input field in the layout creation dialog.
neowiki-layout-creator-name-placeholder: Placeholder text for the layout name input field in the layout creation dialog.
neowiki-layout-creator-name-required: Error shown when the layout name field is empty in the layout creation dialog.
neowiki-layout-creator-name-taken: Error shown when a layout with the entered name already exists in the layout creation dialog.
neowiki-layout-creator-schema-field: Label for the schema selector in the layout creation dialog.
neowiki-layout-creator-schema-placeholde: Placeholder text for the schema selector in the layout creation dialog.
neowiki-layout-creator-view-type-field: Label for the view type selector in the layout creation dialog.
neowiki-layout-creator-view-type-placeho: Placeholder text for the view type selector in the layout creation dialog.
neowiki-layout-creator-save: Label for the save button in the layout creation dialog.
neowiki-layout-creator-success: Success notification shown after creating a layout. $1 is the layout name.
neowiki-layout-creator-error: Error notification title shown when creating a layout fails. $1 is the layout name.
neowiki-layout-creator-summary-default: Default edit summary used when creating a layout via the UI.
neowiki-layout-delete: Aria label for the delete button on a Layout row in the layouts list.
neowiki-property-type-select: Label for the select/dropdown property type shown in the property type selector.
neowiki-property-editor-name-required: Error shown under the property name field in the schema editor when the name is empty.
neowiki-property-editor-name-taken: Error shown under the property name field in the schema editor when another property of the schema already has the entered name. $1 is the entered name.
neowiki-property-editor-min-exceeds-max: Error shown in the schema editor when the minimum value exceeds the maximum value for a number property.
neowiki-property-editor-options: Label for the options field in the select property type editor, where schema creators define the allowed values.
neowiki-property-editor-options-unique: Error shown in the schema editor when duplicate option values are entered for a select property.
neowiki-property-editor-single-value: Name of the single-value Constraint in the schema editor, used as $1 in {{msg-mw|neowiki-severity-input-label}} for the severity control next to {{msg-mw|neowiki-property-editor-multiple}}. The Constraint applies while multiple values are not allowed, so it cannot be named after that checkbox.
neowiki-severity-warning:
Name of the warning severity level of a Constraint: a violation is flagged but never blocks saving. Shown in the severity control's menu in the schema editor and as $1 in {{msg-mw|neowiki-severity-input-label}}.
{{Identical|Warning}}
neowiki-severity-warning-description: One-line meaning of the warning severity level, shown under {{msg-mw|neowiki-severity-warning}} in the severity control's menu in the schema editor. A constraint violation is the finding a Constraint yields when data does not satisfy it; marking them as warnings reports them to editors without ever rejecting a save. Parallel to {{msg-mw|neowiki-severity-error-description-not-enforced}}, which differs only in the severity named.
neowiki-severity-error:
Name of the error severity level of a Constraint: a violation can block saving when the wiki enforces validation. Shown in the severity control's menu in the schema editor and as $1 in {{msg-mw|neowiki-severity-input-label}}.
{{Identical|Error}}
neowiki-severity-error-description-enfor: One-line meaning of the error severity level on a wiki that enforces validation, shown under {{msg-mw|neowiki-severity-error}} in the severity control's menu in the schema editor. "New" is load-bearing: such a wiki rejects only writes that introduce a violation that was not already present, so Subjects that are already invalid stay editable. See also {{msg-mw|neowiki-severity-error-description-not-enforced}}.
neowiki-severity-error-description-not-e: One-line meaning of the error severity level on a wiki that does not enforce validation, shown under {{msg-mw|neowiki-severity-error}} in the severity control's menu in the schema editor. Nothing blocks saving on such a wiki, so the level only decides how violations are reported to editors. Parallel to {{msg-mw|neowiki-severity-warning-description}}, which differs only in the severity named. See also {{msg-mw|neowiki-severity-error-description-enforced}}.
neowiki-property-editor-target-schema: Label for the target-schema picker in the schema property editor. Selects which schema a relation points to.
neowiki-property-editor-target-schema-re: Validation error shown when no target schema is selected.
neowiki-field-invalid-option: Validation error shown when a selected value is not in the allowed options list. $1 is the invalid value.
neowiki-field-single-value-only: Validation error shown when multiple values are selected for a single-select property.
neowiki-field-type-mismatch: Validation error shown when a Statement's stored type no longer matches the property's current type (e.g. the Schema changed after the value was saved). $1 is the type the value was written as; $2 is the type the property now expects.
neowiki-field-schema-not-found: Form-level error shown when the backend reports the Subject's Schema page is missing. $1 is the schema name.
neowiki-field-unregistered-type: Validation warning shown when a Statement's Property Type is not registered, because the extension providing it is disabled or failed to load. The value is preserved but cannot be displayed or edited. $1 is the property type name.
neowiki-field-min-length: Validation error shown when a text value is shorter than the property's minimum length. $1 is the minimum number of characters.
neowiki-field-max-length: Validation error shown when a text value is longer than the property's maximum length. $1 is the maximum number of characters.
neowiki-field-relation-target-schema-mis: Validation error shown when a relation points to a subject whose schema is not the relation's declared target schema. $1 is the required target schema; $2 is the schema the target subject actually uses.
neowiki-field-relation-target-not-found: Validation warning shown when a relation points to a subject ID the wiki cannot resolve for this user, either because no such subject exists or because it lives on a page the user may not read. $1 is the target subject ID. Word it so it does not assert the subject is absent, which would be wrong in the second case. Non-blocking: the target may be created later (for example during import), mirroring wiki red links.
neowiki-field-relation-target-unresolvab: Validation error shown when a relation points to a subject ID whose source key names a subject source this wiki has not registered. $1 is the target subject ID, in its "sourceKey:localId" form. Severity error: like every other error, it blocks the write only when the wiki enforces validation.
neowiki-select-placeholder: Placeholder text shown in the select dropdown before any option is chosen.
neowiki-select-no-results: Message shown in the multi-select dropdown when the typed text does not match any available option.
neowiki-field-invalid-number: Validation error shown under a number field whose text cannot be interpreted as a number. Also shown as an error notification, titled with the property name, when an action is held because a number field holds such text.
neowiki-field-invalid-datetime: Validation error shown when the entered date and time value cannot be parsed. DateTime values must be strict ISO 8601 / xsd:dateTime strings with an explicit timezone offset or 'Z' (for example, '2025-06-15T12:00:00Z' or '2025-06-15T12:00:00+02:00'). Partial values such as year-only or date-only are rejected, and min/max bounds are inclusive.
neowiki-property-type-datetime: Label for the date and time property type in the schema editor
neowiki-field-invalid-date: Validation error shown when the entered date value cannot be parsed. Date values must be strict ISO 8601 calendar dates in YYYY-MM-DD form with no time or timezone component (for example, '2025-06-15'). Values with a time part, partial values such as year-only, and calendar overflows such as '2025-02-30' are rejected, and min/max bounds are inclusive.
neowiki-property-type-date: Label for the date (without time) property type in the schema editor
neowiki-property-type-boolean: Label for the boolean (true/false) property type shown in the property type selector.
neowiki-property-type-unregistered: Label shown in place of a property type name when the type is not registered (e.g. owned by a disabled or failed extension).
neowiki-property-type-unregistered-note: Muted note shown next to a value whose property type is not registered. $1 is the stored type name (e.g. 'color').
neowiki-property-type-unregistered-input: Muted note shown in the value editor for a property whose type is not registered, explaining the value is read-only and preserved unchanged. $1 is the stored type name.
neowiki-property-type-unregistered-attri: Muted note shown in the schema property editor in place of the type-specific attribute inputs when the property type is not registered, explaining the stored settings are preserved but not editable.
neowiki-property-type-unregistered-notif: Warning notification shown once per page when it contains data of a property type that is not registered (e.g. owned by a disabled or failed extension). $1 is the stored type name.
neowiki-boolean-true: Label shown in the value display for a boolean property whose value is true (e.g. in the infobox or schema-table 'Initial value' column).
neowiki-boolean-false: Label shown in the value display for a boolean property whose value is false (e.g. in the infobox or schema-table 'Initial value' column).
neowiki-select-unknown-option: Placeholder shown in a select-property display when a stored option ID cannot be resolved to a label (e.g. the option was removed from the Schema).
neowiki-managesubjects-tab: Label for the Data tab that appears alongside the standard action tabs (View, Edit, History) on content pages, linking to the Subject management page.
neowiki-managesubjects-title: Title of the Subject management page. $1 is the prefixed page title (e.g. 'Berlin').
neowiki-managesubjects-not-applicable: Error shown when the Subject management page is opened on a page that cannot have Subjects (e.g. a Special page or a non-existent page).
neowiki-managesubjects-add-button: Label for the button that opens the Subject creation flow from the Subject management page.
neowiki-managesubjects-empty-title: Heading of the large zero-state shown on the Subject management page when the page has neither a Main Subject nor any other Subjects.
neowiki-managesubjects-empty-description: Descriptive subtitle below {{msg-mw|neowiki-managesubjects-empty-title}} explaining what Subjects are and inviting the user to add one.
neowiki-managesubjects-no-main-title: Heading of the placeholder shown in the Main Subject slot when the page has other Subjects but no Main Subject assigned.
neowiki-managesubjects-no-main-descripti: Subtitle under {{msg-mw|neowiki-managesubjects-no-main-title}} explaining how to assign a Main Subject and what the Main Subject represents.
neowiki-managesubjects-count: Subtle text on the Subject management toolbar showing the total number of Subjects on the page. $1 is the count.
neowiki-managesubjects-main-subject-set: Notification confirming a Subject was promoted to Main Subject. $1 is the name the subject is shown under, read after the promotion, so it names the page rather than being a stand-in. Keep the quotation marks around it.
neowiki-managesubjects-main-subject-clea: Notification confirming the page no longer has a Main Subject.
neowiki-managesubjects-reordered: Notification confirming the subjects on the page were reordered via drag.
neowiki-managesubjects-ordering-error: Notification shown when a drag operation (reorder, promote, demote) failed to persist.
neowiki-managesubjects-main-subject-erro: Notification shown when changing the Main Subject failed.
neowiki-managesubjects-main-subject-indi: Accessible label and tooltip for the pin icon that marks a row as the Main Subject of the page.
neowiki-managesubjects-other-subjects-he: Heading above the list of non-main Subjects on the Subject management page.
neowiki-managesubjects-row-edit: Aria/button label for editing a Subject from its row.
neowiki-managesubjects-row-delete: Aria/button label for deleting a Subject from its row.
neowiki-managesubjects-row-move: Label and tooltip of the button that opens the dialog for moving a subject to another page.
neowiki-managesubjects-move-title: Title of the dialog for moving a subject to another page.
neowiki-managesubjects-move-target-label: Label of the field naming the page the subject is moved to.
neowiki-managesubjects-move-creates-page:
Note shown when the chosen target page does not exist yet. Parameters:
* $1 - the title of the page that will be created
neowiki-managesubjects-move-make-main: Label of the checkbox that makes the moved subject the main subject of the page it is moved to. Says "the target page" rather than "this page", which in this UI means the page being viewed.
neowiki-managesubjects-move-demotes:
Note shown under the main-subject checkbox when the target page already has a main subject, which the move would demote to one of the page's other subjects. Parameters:
* $1 - the display name of the target page's current main subject
neowiki-managesubjects-move-source-loses:
Warning shown when the subject being moved is the main subject of the page it is moved away from. Parameters:
* $1 - the title of the page the subject is moved away from
neowiki-managesubjects-move-confirm-butt: Label of the button that performs the move.
neowiki-managesubjects-move-success:
Notification shown after a subject was moved. Parameters:
* $1 - the display name of the moved subject
* $2 - a link to the page it was moved to, labelled with that page's title
neowiki-managesubjects-move-error:
Notification shown when moving a subject failed for an unrecognised reason. Parameters:
* $1 - the display name of the subject that could not be moved
neowiki-managesubjects-move-page-taken: Error shown when the page the move was going to create already exists.
neowiki-managesubjects-move-create-page-: Default edit summary for the empty page created to hold a moved subject.

Error shown when the target page could not be created. Parameters:
* $1 - the title of the page that could not be created
neowiki-managesubjects-row-promote: Aria/button label for the pin button that promotes one of the page's other Subjects to its Main Subject.
neowiki-managesubjects-row-demote: Aria/button label for the pin button on the Main Subject row that clears it so the page has no Main Subject.
neowiki-managesubjects-row-copy-link: Aria/button label for the row action (an inline button on wide viewports, an overflow-menu item on narrow ones) that copies a shareable link to this Subject.
neowiki-managesubjects-row-more: Aria/button label for the overflow (kebab) menu that lists per-row actions on narrow viewports.
neowiki-managesubjects-row-drag-handle: Tooltip on the drag handle on each Subject row (sighted mouse users only — the handle is not in the focus order). Dragging a row within the list of other Subjects reorders it. Dragging such a row onto the Main Subject slot promotes it (and demotes the previous main into the dragged row's slot). Dragging the Main Subject row into the list of other Subjects demotes it at the drop position.
neowiki-managesubjects-statement-count: Shown on each collapsed Subject row to indicate how many Statements the Subject has. $1 is the count.
neowiki-managesubjects-no-statements: Empty-state shown inside an expanded Subject row when the Subject has no statements.
neowiki-managesubjects-delete-summary-de: Default edit summary used when deleting a Subject from the Subject management page.
neowiki-managesubjects-delete-confirm-ti: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before deleting a Subject.
neowiki-managesubjects-delete-confirm-me: Body of the delete confirmation dialog. $1 is the name the subject is shown under, rendered in bold, which is why it carries no quotation marks.
neowiki-managesubjects-delete-confirm-bu: Label for the destructive confirm-button in the delete dialog.
neowiki-managesubjects-delete-success: Notification confirming a Subject was deleted. Shown immediately after the deletion on the Manage Subjects page, with no page reload.
neowiki-managesubjects-delete-error: Notification shown when deleting a Subject failed. $1 is the name the subject is shown under: a stored label, or a bracketed stand-in such as "(unnamed Attendance)" for a subject nobody named. Keep the quotation marks around it, because a stored label is arbitrary text and needs delimiting.
neowiki-managesubjects-load-error: Notification shown when loading the Subject list for the page failed.
neowiki-managesubjects-id-label: Inline label shown before the Subject ID in the footer of an expanded Subject row. Typically short, e.g. "ID:".
neowiki-managesubjects-id-copy: Tooltip on the subject ID button. $1 is the Subject ID. Click copies the ID to the clipboard.
neowiki-managesubjects-id-copied: Notification shown after the subject ID was copied. $1 is the Subject ID.
neowiki-managesubjects-id-copy-error: Notification shown when copying the subject ID to the clipboard failed.
neowiki-managesubjects-iri-label: Inline label shown before the Subject IRI (its RDF concept URI) in the footer of an expanded Subject row. Typically short, e.g. "IRI:".
neowiki-managesubjects-iri-copy: Tooltip on the subject IRI button. $1 is the Subject IRI. Click copies the IRI to the clipboard.
neowiki-managesubjects-iri-copied: Notification shown after the subject IRI was copied. $1 is the Subject IRI.
neowiki-managesubjects-iri-copy-error: Notification shown when copying the subject IRI to the clipboard failed.
neowiki-managesubjects-link-copied: Notification shown after the deep link to a Subject's row was copied to the clipboard. Takes no parameters.
neowiki-managesubjects-link-copy-error: Notification shown when copying the deep link to the clipboard failed.
neowiki-managesubjects-export-all-button: Label and accessible name of the button in the Data-tab header that opens the export menu for all Subjects on the page. See {{msg-neowiki|neowiki-managesubjects-export-button}} for the per-Subject equivalent.
neowiki-managesubjects-export-button: Label and accessible name of the button that opens the data export menu for a single Subject on the Data tab.
neowiki-managesubjects-export-json: Export menu item that downloads the raw JSON representation of the Subject or page.
neowiki-managesubjects-export-format-tur: Level-1 export menu item selecting the Turtle serialization; reveals the projection list. "Turtle" is the RDF serialization format name and is not translated.
neowiki-managesubjects-export-format-tri: Level-1 export menu item selecting the TriG serialization; reveals the projection list. "TriG" is the RDF serialization format name and is not translated.
neowiki-managesubjects-export-back: Export menu item that returns from the projection list to the serialization choice.
neowiki-managesubjects-export-choose-for: Announced to screen-reader users when the data export menu returns to its list of export formats (JSON, Turtle, TriG).
neowiki-managesubjects-export-choose-pro: Announced to screen-reader users when the data export menu shows its list of projections after a format is chosen. A projection is a named RDF rendering of the data, e.g. EDM or CIDOC-CRM.
neowiki-managesubjects-export-native: Display name of the native (NeoWiki-vocabulary) RDF projection, shown in the projection list of the data export menu.
action-subjects: Description of the Subject management action used by MediaWiki when generating action descriptions.
neowiki-config-invalid: Heading shown above the list of errors when an edit to the MediaWiki:NeoWiki JSON configuration page is rejected.
neowiki-config-error-not-object: Error shown when the MediaWiki:NeoWiki configuration is not a JSON object.
neowiki-config-error-unknown-key: Error shown when the configuration contains a setting that is not exposed on-wiki. $1 is the unknown key.
neowiki-config-error-invalid-boolean: Error shown when a setting that must be a boolean is not. $1 is the setting key. The words "true" and "false" are literal JSON values and must not be translated.
neowiki-config-type-boolean: Accepted-value description in the configuration reference table for a boolean setting. Contains HTML: the literal JSON values "true" and "false", each wrapped in a <code> tag, must not be translated.
neowiki-config-docs-heading: Heading of the configuration reference shown on the MediaWiki:NeoWiki configuration page. Also the link target of {{msg-neowiki|neowiki-config-docs-pointer}}.
neowiki-config-docs-pointer: One-line pointer shown above the configuration editor and view. $1 is the anchor of the on-page reference, $2 is the URL of the external documentation.
neowiki-config-docs-column-key: Column header in the configuration reference table for the setting key written on the page.
neowiki-config-docs-column-value: Column header in the configuration reference table for the value the setting accepts.
neowiki-config-docs-column-setting: Column header in the configuration reference table for the LocalSettings.php setting that the page key overrides.
neowiki-special-graphstores: Title and description of the [[Special:GraphStores]] page, which reports and rebuilds the wiki's graph stores. Also the title of its card on [[Special:NeoWiki]].
neowiki-graphstores-intro: Introduction shown above the store table on [[Special:GraphStores]].
neowiki-graphstores-nostores: Shown on [[Special:GraphStores]] instead of the introduction and the store table when no graph store is configured.
neowiki-graphstores-column-store:
Column heading on [[Special:GraphStores]]: the store's configured name.
{{Identical|Store}}
neowiki-graphstores-column-projection: Column heading on [[Special:GraphStores]]: the RDF vocabulary the store holds.
neowiki-graphstores-column-state:
Column heading on [[Special:GraphStores]]: how far the store is from the wiki.
{{Identical|State}}
neowiki-graphstores-column-lastrebuild: Column heading on [[Special:GraphStores]]: when the store was last rebuilt successfully.
neowiki-graphstores-column-actions:
Column heading on [[Special:GraphStores]]: the buttons that start or stop a rebuild.
{{Identical|Actions}}
neowiki-graphstores-projection-none:
{{optional}}
Shown in the projection column on [[Special:GraphStores]] for a backend that holds no RDF, such as Neo4j. The English message is an em dash.
neowiki-graphstores-state-insync: State on [[Special:GraphStores]]: the store's copy matches the wiki.
neowiki-graphstores-state-stale:
State on [[Special:GraphStores]]: the Mapping page defining the store's projection was edited or deleted after that store's last successful rebuild started, so the store still describes pages with the old vocabulary.

Parameters:
* $1 - when that Mapping page last changed, already formatted as a date and time in the user's language
neowiki-graphstores-state-neverbuilt: State on [[Special:GraphStores]]: no rebuild of this store ever reconciled the whole wiki — it never ran, or every run so far left pages failed.
neowiki-graphstores-state-queued: State on [[Special:GraphStores]]: a rebuild has been queued but has not started.
neowiki-graphstores-state-running:
State on [[Special:GraphStores]]: a rebuild is under way.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of pages projected so far
* $2 - number of pages the rebuild could not reconcile
neowiki-graphstores-lastrebuild:
Last rebuild column on [[Special:GraphStores]], for the store's last successful rebuild.

Parameters:
* $1 - when that rebuild finished, already formatted as a date and time in the user's language
* $2 - number of pages it projected
* $3 - number of pages it could not reconcile
neowiki-graphstores-lastrebuild-never:
Shown in the last rebuild column on [[Special:GraphStores]] when no rebuild of the store has ever succeeded.
{{Identical|Never}}
neowiki-graphstores-rebuild: Label of the button on [[Special:GraphStores]] that queues a rebuild of one store.
neowiki-graphstores-cancel: Label of the button on [[Special:GraphStores]] that stops the rebuild a store has queued or running.
neowiki-graphstores-outcome-queued:
Confirmation shown on [[Special:GraphStores]] after queueing a rebuild.

Parameters:
* $1 - name of the graph store
neowiki-graphstores-outcome-cancelled:
Confirmation shown on [[Special:GraphStores]] after cancelling a rebuild.

Parameters:
* $1 - name of the graph store
neowiki-graphstores-outcome-alreadyrunni:
Error shown on [[Special:GraphStores]] when a rebuild was asked for a store that already has one.

Parameters:
* $1 - name of the graph store
neowiki-graphstores-outcome-nothingtocan:
Error shown on [[Special:GraphStores]] when a cancellation was asked for a store with no rebuild.

Parameters:
* $1 - name of the graph store
neowiki-graphstores-outcome-unknownstore:
Error shown on [[Special:GraphStores]] when the named store is not configured.

Parameters:
* $1 - name that was asked for
neowiki-graphstores-outcome-notqueued:
Error shown on [[Special:GraphStores]] when a rebuild could not be started at all — the job queue refused it, or something else held the store's start lock.

Parameters:
* $1 - name of the graph store
neowiki-graphstores-outcome-sessionfailu: Error shown on [[Special:GraphStores]] when the edit token of a rebuild or cancel form did not match.
neowiki-special-subject:
Name of the [[Special:Subject]] page, which shows one Subject. Used in the list of special pages, and as the page's heading when it shows no Subject.
{{Identical|Subject}}
neowiki-special-subject-invalid-id: Error shown on [[Special:Subject]] when it is opened with no subject ID, or with something that is not one. The example ID stays as it is.
neowiki-special-subject-page-label: Inline label shown before a link to the wiki page a Subject is stored on, in the footer of an expanded Subject row.
neowiki-special-subject-referenced-headi: Heading on [[Special:Subject]] above the Subjects the displayed Subject's relations point at.
neowiki-special-subject-not-found:
Shown on [[Special:Subject]] in place of the Subject when the wiki has no Subject with that ID. It is also shown for a Subject on a page the reader may not read, so the translation must not mention permissions.

Parameters:
* $1 - the Subject ID that was asked for
neowiki-special-subject-load-error: Shown on [[Special:Subject]] when loading a Subject failed with a network or server error: in place of the Subject on first load, and as a notification when a re-read after a change failed. Distinct from {{msg-neowiki|neowiki-special-subject-not-found}}, which says the wiki has no such Subject.
neowiki-managesubjects-row-open: Label for two ways to the same place in a Subject row: the inline action, and the item in the overflow menu that replaces the inline actions on narrow viewports. Both go to [[Special:Subject]], the page showing that one Subject. On a subject-first wiki the Subject's name links there too, and the inline action is then left out. It navigates; it does not expand the row.
neowiki-special-subject-referenced-by-he: Heading on [[Special:Subject]] above the Subjects whose relations point at the displayed Subject. The opposite direction of {{msg-neowiki|neowiki-special-subject-referenced-heading}}.
neowiki-special-subject-referenced-by-tr:
Shown on [[Special:Subject]] below the list of Subjects referencing the displayed one, when more exist than the list shows. The total is unknown, so the translation must not imply one.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of Subjects listed
neowiki-create-subject-default-label:
Label of the button {{#create_subject}} places on a page to open the 'create subject' dialog. Used when the wikitext gives neither a label nor a Schema; with a Schema, {{msg-neowiki|neowiki-schema-create-subject}} is used instead.
{{Identical|Create subject}}
neowiki-create-subject-error-positional:
Error shown in place of the {{#create_subject}} button when it is called with an argument that has no name. Parameters:
* $1 - the offending argument
neowiki-create-subject-error-unknown-arg:
Error shown in place of the {{#create_subject}} button when it receives an unrecognized named argument. Parameters:
* $1 - the offending argument name
neowiki-create-subject-error-unknown-sch:
Error shown in place of the {{#create_subject}} button when the Schema it names does not exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the Schema name that was asked for
neowiki-create-subject-error-invalid-pag:
Error shown in place of the {{#create_subject}} button when the page it names cannot be a page of this wiki: a malformed title, an interwiki link, or a special page. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title that was asked for
neowiki-create-subject-error-uncreatable:
Error shown in place of the {{#create_subject}} button when the page it names does not exist and is outside the main namespace. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title that was asked for
neowiki-create-subject-denied: Body of the dialog the {{#create_subject}} button opens for a user who may not create a subject, used when the wiki supplied no reason of its own.
neowiki-special-neowiki:
Title and description of the [[Special:NeoWiki]] page, which lists the wiki's Schemas, creates Subjects, and links to the other NeoWiki pages. "NeoWiki" is the extension name and stays untranslated.
{{Identical|NeoWiki}}
neowiki-sidebar-overview: Label for the link in the NeoWiki section of the sidebar that navigates to [[Special:NeoWiki]].
neowiki-overview-layouts-description: Short description shown under the [[Special:Layouts]] link on [[Special:NeoWiki]].
neowiki-overview-mappings-description: Short description shown under the [[Special:Mappings]] link on [[Special:NeoWiki]]. EDM and CIDOC-CRM are ontology names and stay untranslated.
neowiki-overview-graph-stores-descriptio: Short description shown under the [[Special:GraphStores]] link on [[Special:NeoWiki]].
neowiki-overview-configuration:
Label of the link to [[MediaWiki:NeoWiki]] on [[Special:NeoWiki]], the page holding the wiki's NeoWiki settings.
{{Identical|Configuration}}
neowiki-overview-configuration-descripti: Short description shown under the [[MediaWiki:NeoWiki]] link on [[Special:NeoWiki]]. "Without server access" contrasts it with the settings that can only be changed in LocalSettings.php.
neowiki-overview-manage-schemas: Label of the link in the header of the Schema table on [[Special:NeoWiki]] that navigates to [[Special:Schemas]], where Schemas are created, edited and deleted.
